coordinate_frame: local x left-to-right when facing entrance; -y front; +z up. No geographic orientation asserted.
scale_status: Relative photograph estimates only. No surveyed dimensions or claimed real scale. Classroom-use chart is not measured.

manufacturing.roof_interface: Plain flat butt joint; no pegs, sockets, internal supports or snap fit. Center manually; glue after trial placement.

parameter_semantics.geometry_control_limit: The listed fields are read by the generator; other fixed coordinates remain in source. This is not a fully constrained free-form parametric building model. Declaration-only values do not resize geometry.
parameter_semantics.fixed_door_construction: Source uses porch depth+0.4 and door cut center_y=-28.9, depth=0.7. Raw STL front_y=-29.200000763 and door_back_y=-28.549999237 give depth=0.650001526mm (nominal declaration 0.65mm).
parameter_semantics.fixed_window_construction: Ordinary window relief is nominally 0.4mm and is made by fixed source coordinates; relief.window_depth/window_height are declarations, not active dimensions.
parameter_semantics.door_top_gcode_path: Saved body G-code Overhang perimeter runs from model(-8.3,-28.975,20.2) to(8.3,-28.975,20.2), length16.6mm; recess depth is not bridge/overhang path length.
